reviewer: /root/y3_research_plan — independent AI research/plan reviewer; no student-facing authorship
scope: Ten descriptors, all saved elaborations,32 planned focuses, baseline retained teaching and model requirements.
decision: PASS — READY TO DRAFT for all ten public Topic Guides

focus_decisions.learning_intention: Share turns and check group understanding
Adjust language to audience, role and formality
Negotiate, affirm and develop ideas together

code_decisions.bounded_repairs_required: Retain restating/building responses and source-specific cultural caution. Voice pace/volume is supporting formality context, not a new assessed delivery requirement.

focus_decisions.learning_intention: Compare modal probability and obligation in context
Explain evaluations made by nouns, verbs and adverbs
Express emotion and judgements with suitable force

code_decisions.bounded_repairs_required: Retain evidence-backed opinion and evaluation contrasts; repair might/should/will comparison by supplying context and separating probability from obligation. Subjective/objective contrast is support only.

focus_decisions.learning_intention: Compare factual recount and autobiography
Compare information report and sequential explanation
Compare narrative, verse poetry and personal literary response
Explain the stages of a simple argument

code_decisions.bounded_repairs_required: Retain structure-purpose examples and Mia/she/it cohesion model as supporting organisation; do not let cohesion replace eight required text-type coverage.

focus_decisions.learning_intention: Group information and develop an informative paragraph
Order and repair paragraphs for a reader
Compare narrative paragraph choices

code_decisions.bounded_repairs_required: Retain paragraph-focus and mixed-text repair. Procedure/story/report overview is background; pronoun model supports continuity rather than replacing paragraph organisation.

focus_decisions.learning_intention: Use print headings, subheadings and chapter titles
Follow meaningful hyperlinks and navigation words
Compare routes and verify the information found

code_decisions.bounded_repairs_required: Generic structure, cohesion and paragraph block needs bounded relevance repair: reframe around actual headings/links/chapter navigation; do not retain pronoun substitution as core LA05 teaching.

focus_decisions.learning_intention: Find clauses through subject and verb links
Match singular and plural subjects with verbs
Repair agreement while retaining meaning

code_decisions.bounded_repairs_required: Retain Birds fly/expanded birds model for subject/verb links and because/so pair for clause locating only. Replace passive-voice comparison as off-focus; no active/passive formalism.

focus_decisions.learning_intention: Explain doing and saying verbs in narratives
Use thinking and feeling verbs to reveal inner experience
Use relating verbs in definitions and descriptions

code_decisions.bounded_repairs_required: Copied evaluation/modal/subjective-objective block is mismatched. Recast any retained story judgement only to identify thinking/feeling/saying/relating processes; remove unconnected modal-force instruction.

focus_decisions.learning_intention: Read whole verb groups with time clues
Change regular and common irregular verb forms
Maintain a clear timeline and explain time changes

code_decisions.bounded_repairs_required: Retain Birds fly as present habit only with time contrast. Because/so example is context for timeline only; replace passive-voice comparison as off-focus.

focus_decisions.learning_intention: Read character relationships through visible choices
Explain viewer involvement through gaze and framing
Combine words and images without inventing a backstory

code_decisions.bounded_repairs_required: Retain caption contribution, close/wide framing and exact map SVG/route model. Layout navigation is supporting image organisation, not central LA05-style navigation assessment. Muddy/torn-map try needs visible asset or must be explicitly text-description reasoning.

focus_decisions.learning_intention: Use precise technical words for length
Use narrative terms to explain a story
Check a word meaning against its context
Extend vocabulary through meaningful word parts

code_decisions.bounded_repairs_required: Retain meaningful word-part families. Remove spelling-choice/etymology-only detour; teach technical vocabulary and context senses explicitly.

required_delivery_conditions: Every focus uses original worked modelling, distinct guided try and independent check with response criteria.
LA01 includes sourced role distinction and locally supplied host guidance; no invented cultural protocol.
LA03 includes all eight complete named text types plus argument stages.
LA05 hyperlinks have actual matching destination IDs and heading/content confirmation.
LA09 actual images support assessed interpretation; map SVG preserved; alt text equivalent to visible evidence, no answer-only inference.
Independent authored content and rendered-output checks still required before completion.
limitations: LA08 current Scootle elaboration retrieval unavailable after retries; official QCAA confirms descriptor; exact previously saved elaborations preserved and consistent current secondary copies inspected. This is a retrieval limit, not a claim of fresh primary elaboration inspection.
No learner trial, media playback, full IXL progression or finished product certification.
Historical independent records are not substituted for present analysis.
